section: Massachusetts property tax: state rules: figures under review
label: Levy limits (Proposition 2½)
value: A municipality's levy may not exceed 2.5% of the full and fair cash value of its taxable property (levy ceiling), and the annual levy limit may grow only 2.5% a year plus new growth unless voters approve an override
note: G.L. c. 59 s. 21C. Overrides can raise the levy limit but never above the ceiling. Seen only in search snippets of DLS material.
source_title: Mass.gov (Division of Local Services): Chapter 5, Setting the Tax Rate

label: Deeds excise (state tax stamps) rate
value: $2.28 per $500 of value (equals $4.56 per $1,000), outside Barnstable County
note: Statewide rate set by G.L. c. 64D; Barnstable County differs. Paid at the Registry of Deeds and forwarded to the Department of Revenue.
source_title: Berkshire Middle District Registry of Deeds: Tax Stamps

label: Who pays the deeds excise
note: Stated for Berkshire County; the buyer pays the recording fees for the deed and mortgage.
source_title: Berkshire Middle District Registry of Deeds: Tax Stamps
